channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2021-39226 — Grafana Labs Grafana
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Grafana contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated and unauthenticated users to view and delete all snapshot data, potentially resulting in complete snapshot data loss.

item.title: CVE-2022-22963 — VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud
item.description: Threat Signal 80. When using routing functionality in VMware Tanzu's Spring Cloud Function, it is possible for a user to provide a specially crafted SpEL as a routing-expression that may result in remote code execution and access to local resources.

item.title: CVE-2022-22536 — SAP Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 80. SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP, SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java, ABAP Platform, SAP Content Server and SAP Web Dispatcher allow HTTP request smuggling. An unauthenticated attacker can prepend a victim's request with arbitrary data, allowing for function execution impersonating the victim or poisoning intermediary Web caches.

item.title: CVE-2017-15944 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains multiple, unspecified vulnerabilities which can allow for remote code execution when chained.

item.title: CVE-2022-26138 — Atlassian Confluence
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Atlassian Questions For Confluence App has hard-coded credentials, exposing the username and password in plaintext. A remote unauthenticated attacker can use these credentials to log into Confluence and access all content accessible to users in the confluence-users group.

item.title: CVE-2018-2628 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated attacker with T3 network access to compromise the server.

item.title: CVE-2017-8291 — Artifex Ghostscript
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Artifex Ghostscript allows -dSAFER bypass and remote command execution via .rsdparams type confusion with a "/OutputFile.

item.title: CVE-2012-0754 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Adobe Flash Player contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2012-0151 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 74. The Authenticode Signature Verification function in Microsoft Windows (WinVerifyTrust) does not properly validate the digest of a signed portable executable (PE) file, which allows user-assisted remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2017-5521 — NETGEAR Multiple Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Multiple NETGEAR devices are prone to admin password disclosure via simple crafted requests to the web management server.

item.title: CVE-2010-0840 — Oracle Java Runtime Environment (JRE)
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Unspecified vulnerability in the Java Runtime Environment (JRE) in Java SE component allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability via Unknown vectors.

item.title: CVE-2022-27925 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains flaw in the mboximport functionality, allowing an authenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-37042 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-24706 — Apache CouchDB
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Apache CouchDB contains an insecure default initialization of resource vulnerability which can allow an attacker to escalate to administrative privileges.

item.title: CVE-2022-24112 — Apache APISIX
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Apache APISIX contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2007-5659 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a PDF file with long arguments to unspecified JavaScript methods.

item.title: CVE-2017-0147 — Microsoft SMBv1 server
item.description: Threat Signal 85. The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory via a crafted packet.

item.title: CVE-2022-30333 — RARLAB UnRAR
item.description: Threat Signal 85. RARLAB UnRAR on Linux and UNIX contains a directory traversal vulnerability, allowing an attacker to write to files during an extract (unpack) operation.

item.title: CVE-2020-28949 — PEAR Archive_Tar
item.description: Threat Signal 73. PEAR Archive_Tar allows an unserialization attack because phar: is blocked but PHAR: is not blocked. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

item.title: CVE-2010-2883 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2022-30190 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 86. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when MSDT is called using the URL protocol from a calling application such as Word. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability can run code with the privileges of the calling application.

item.title: CVE-2011-2462 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 78. The Universal 3D (U3D) component in Adobe Reader and Acrobat contains a memory corruption vulnerability which could allow remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2010-1297 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Adobe Flash Player contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2009-4324 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Acrobat and Reader allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted PDF file.

item.title: CVE-2022-27924 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) allows an attacker to inject memcache commands into a targeted instance which causes an overwrite of arbitrary cached entries.

item.title: CVE-2022-26258 — D-Link DIR-820L
item.description: Threat Signal 78. D-Link DIR-820L contains an unspecified vulnerability in Device Name parameter in /lan.asp which allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2013-1331 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Office contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via crafted PNG data in an Office document.

item.title: CVE-2012-4969 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2021-4034 — Red Hat Polkit
item.description: Threat Signal 85. The Red Hat polkit pkexec utility contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation with administrative rights.

item.title: CVE-2012-1889 — Microsoft XML Core Services
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft XML Core Services contains a memory corruption vulnerability which could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2009-3953 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains an array boundary issue in Universal 3D (U3D) support that could lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2013-0431 — Oracle Java Runtime Environment (JRE)
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Unspecified vulnerability in the Java Runtime Environment (JRE) component in Oracle allows remote attackers to bypass the Java security sandbox.

item.title: CVE-2018-17463 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2022-26923 — Microsoft Active Directory
item.description: Threat Signal 75. An authenticated user could manipulate attributes on computer accounts they own or manage, and acquire a certificate from Active Directory Certificate Services that would allow for privilege escalation to SYSTEM.

item.title: CVE-2015-0016 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Directory traversal vulnerability in the TS WebProxy (TSWbPrxy) component in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2013-0074 — Microsoft Silverlight
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Silverlight does not properly validate pointers during HTML object rendering, which allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted Silverlight application.

item.title: CVE-2021-38406 — Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 lacks proper validation of user-supplied data when parsing specific project files (improper input validation) resulting in an out-of-bounds write that allows for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-36193 — PEAR Archive_Tar
item.description: Threat Signal 69. PEAR Archive_Tar Tar.php allows write operations with directory traversal due to inadequate checking of symbolic links. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

item.title: CVE-2022-26134 — Atlassian Confluence Server/Data Center
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain a remote code execution vulnerability that allows for an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2016-3393 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A remote code execution vulnerability exists due to the way the Windows GDI component handles objects in the memory. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability could take control of the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2022-27593 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Certain QNAP NAS running Photo Station with internet exposure contain an externally controlled reference to a resource vulnerability which can allow an attacker to modify system files. This vulnerability was observed being utilized in a Deadbolt ransomware campaign.

item.title: CVE-2022-34713 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when Microsoft Windows MSDT is called using the URL protocol from a calling application.

item.title: CVE-2010-0738 — Red Hat JBoss
item.description: Threat Signal 77. The JMX-Console web application in JBossAs in Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Platform performs access control only for the GET and POST methods, which allows remote attackers to send requests to this application's GET handler by using a different method.

item.title: CVE-2013-0422 — Oracle Java Runtime Environment (JRE)
item.description: Threat Signal 89. A vulnerability in the way Java restricts the permissions of Java applets could allow an attacker to execute commands on a vulnerable system.

item.title: CVE-2009-0563 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Office contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a Word document with a crafted tag containing an invalid length field.

item.title: CVE-2018-6530 — D-Link Multiple Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 89. Multiple D-Link routers contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for execution of OS commands.

item.title: CVE-2017-8543 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows allows an attacker to take control of the affected system when Windows Search fails to handle objects in memory.

item.title: CVE-2011-0609 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Adobe Flash Player contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2015-4495 — Mozilla Firefox
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Moxilla Firefox allows remote attackers to bypass the Same Origin Policy to read arbitrary files or gain privileges.

item.title: CVE-2015-8651 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Integer overflow in Adobe Flash Player allows attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2019-7192 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 88. QNAP NAS devices running Photo Station contain an improper access control vulnerability allowing remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the system.
